name: compose-product-portfolio
job: Compose a multi-product portfolio: product-unit boundaries, typed connector graphs, and keep/extract/merge/retire decisions.

inScope: Classifying candidate surfaces on independent axes
Defining product units, connectors, shared substrate, and composed experiences
Drawing the directed connector graph with one contract and state owner per edge
Recording keep/extract/merge/retire decisions with evidence and handoffs
outOfScope: Rewriting another product's domain facts or live state
Forcing product, capability, module, repo, or deployment boundaries one-to-one
Owning pricing, marketing, or delivery execution for the units

inputs: Portfolio objective, target customers, and recurring jobs
Existing products, proposed capabilities, and experience surfaces
outputs: Composable Product Portfolio Contract with product-unit registry
Typed connector graph with complete edge semantics
Keep/extract/merge/retire decisions with expected value and permanent cost

data: current implementation versus desired product semantics

failureSemantics: A feature, module, repo, or runtime cell is never a product without passing the independent product test; cross-product truth never hides inside connectors, shared UI, or integration databases, and dogfooding uses the same supported contract as customers.

outcome.observable: A Composable Product Portfolio Contract where every unit has a standalone job, contract, lifecycle, and support path, every connector edge names its contract and state owner, and decisions carry evidence and handoffs.
